verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI ships a well-documented async Python API (arun/AsyncWebCrawler), a documented CLI (crwl), a Dockerized FastAPI server with an interactive playground, and an official MCP integration for AI tool connectivity — all confirmed by first-party docs and GitHub. This gives AI-native users multiple concrete, documented ways to programmatically drive the tool. Missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/REST spec (probe found 404s on openapi.json/swagger.json paths) and an llms.txt reference, so full API discoverability for machine consumption is incomplete.
